description: Machine-readable conformance scenarios. The platform's conformance runner (`npm run conformance -- --engine-url <url> --token <token>`) executes them against any engine started in conformance mode. Track A runs it against the real ComfyUI-backed engine; CI runs it against the contract mock.

scenarios.name: engine info
scenarios.expect: GET /engine → 200, valid engine-info, contract_versions contains 1.0, capabilities.output_transfer contains http_download, conformance_mode=true

scenarios.name: workflow discovery
scenarios.expect: GET /workflows lists __conformance__.solid_color@1.0.0 with manifest_sha256 equal to sha256(RFC 8785 canonical JSON, minus deprecated/sunset_at) of the manifest from GET /workflows/{key}/versions/{version}

scenarios.name: manifest valid
scenarios.expect: manifest validates against workflow-manifest schema; input_schema matches the normative example

scenarios.name: submit and succeed
scenarios.expect: 202 queued|running; polling reaches succeeded within 60 s; 2 outputs; each output downloads with matching sha256, bytes, image/png, width/height as requested

scenarios.name: idempotent replay
scenarios.expect: re-POST identical body+key → 200 or 202 with the same job_id

scenarios.name: idempotency conflict
scenarios.expect: POST same request_id+attempt with different parameters → 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT

scenarios.name: new attempt
scenarios.expect: same request_id with attempt+1 → new job_id

scenarios.name: cancellation
scenarios.expect: POST /jobs/{id}/cancel while running → cancelling|cancelled; polling reaches cancelled; no outputs; error.code=CANCELLED

scenarios.name: cancel terminal job
scenarios.expect: cancel on a succeeded job → 200 with state still succeeded

scenarios.name: status schema
scenarios.expect: every job status returned during C06–C13 validates against job-status schema
